name: Hogan's Heroes
description:
Hogan's Heroes is an American television sitcom that ran for 168 episodes from September 17, 1965, to July 4, 1971, on the CBS network. The show was set in a German prisoner of war camp during World War II. Bob Crane starred as Colonel Robert E. Hogan, coordinating an international crew of Allied prisoners running a Special Operations group from the camp. Werner Klemperer played Colonel Wilhelm Klink, the commandant of the camp, and John Banner was the inept sergeant-of-the-guard, Hans Schultz.

The series was popular during its six-season run. In 2013, creators Bernard Fein through his estate and Albert S. Ruddy acquired the sequel and other separate rights to Hogan's Heroes from Mark Cuban through arbitration and a movie based on the show has been planned.

videos.overview: Silent footage taken from the set of Hogan's Heroes

videos.title: Richard Dawson Remembers ... The Early Days
A Conversation with Albert S. Ruddy - Co-creator of Hogan's Heroes
Inspiration for the role of Newkirk
The Informer
videos.overview: At Stalag 13, a German prisoner-of-war camp, Colonel Robert Hogan and his fellow cohorts are a subversive group with many hidden talents. However, a spy has been planted amongst the men by the Germans.

videos.title: Hold that Tiger
videos.overview: When Colonel Klink boasts that the Nazis' new Tiger Tank will lead the Germans to victory, Colonel Hogan devises a plan to get his hands on one of the vehicles, have it disassembled, send its blueprints to the Allies, and reassemble it --- right under Klink's nose.

videos.title: Kommandant of the Year
videos.overview: A Secret rocket bomb developed by the Germans is being hidden at Stalag 13. When an Allied scientist is sent to photograph and sabotage the weapon, Hogan and his men plan a distraction — in the form of a bogus "Kommandant of the Year" ceremony for the clueless Colonel Klink.

videos.title: The Late Inspector General
videos.overview: To prevent Colonel Klink from being transferred to the Russian front, Hogan and his men attempt to convince a visiting Inspector General that the Colonel is a cold, heartless disciplinarian. But their plan backfires when, as a result, Klink is promoted to a post in Berlin!

videos.title: The Flight of the Valkyrie
videos.overview: Hogan's scheme to help a German baroness escape to London is thwarted by the arrival of a new prisoner of war, Colonel Crittendon, whose repeated, bungled attempts at escape are wreaking havoc on Hogan's mission to spirit away the baroness.

videos.title: The Prisoner's Prisoner
videos.overview: While on a sabotage caper, Hogan and Carter encounter a German general, overpower him, and smuggle him back to Stalag 13. Once there, they come up with a ploy to trick the disoriented general into revealing his troop's attack plans.

videos.title: German Bridge is Falling Down
videos.overview: Several attempts by Hogan and his men to destroy a German bridge end in failure—until they decide to use the Nazis' own ammo to accomplish the task!

videos.title: Movies Are Your Best Escape
videos.overview: What's inside a visiting German general's briefcase that's chained to his wrist? The mystery becomes too tempting for Hogan, who not only wants to photograph the case's contents, but then sneak the photos out of Stalag 13, as well!

videos.title: Go Light on the Heavy Water
videos.overview: When a heavily guarded "water" truck appears one day and is parked inside the camp, Hogan and his men decide to find out just what kind of cargo the vehicle actually contains.

videos.title: Top Hat, White Tie and Bomb Sight
videos.overview: Hogan's only chance to pass some important information off to an underground contact is via a rendezvous in a nearby village.

videos.title: Happiness is a Warm Sergeant
videos.overview: Sergeant Schultz, while escorting Newkirk to the dentist, gets drunk and is replaced by a hard-lined, no-nonsense guard. Hogan and his crew must act fast to get the docile Schultz restored to his post.

videos.title: The Scientist
videos.overview: LeBeau aids in the escape of a captured French scientist and his daughter, who are able to make it out of Germany. But now the men of Stalag 13 must find a suitable "replacement" scientist who can present and discuss the study's findings.

videos.title: Hogan's Hofbrau
videos.overview: When two ruthless German officers put the squeeze on Colonel Klink to contribute money to their phony cause "or else," Hogan and the gang must scramble to come up with the cash and deliver it in time to keep Klink out of harm's way as the camp's inept Kommandant.

videos.title: Oil for the Lamps of Hogan
videos.overview: The Germans' plan to build a synthetic fuel plant at Stalag 13 would spell disaster for Hogan's men and their important strategic subterfuge. So, Hogan attempts to convince Klink that there's a massive oil supply under the camp.

videos.title: Reservations are Required
videos.overview: An agreement to aid two escapees quickly goes awry when 20 men show up at the appointed hour. Where will Hogan and his gang find uniforms and papers for the men? And how will they get them out of Stalag 13, with German guards stationed near the end of the secret escape tunnel?

videos.title: Anchors Aweigh, Men of Stalag 13
videos.overview: When a British submarine cannot make a planned rendezvous to pick up a POW carrying an prototype of an important new German weapon, Hogan must come up with a sturdy, seaworthy replacement.

videos.title: Happy Birthday, Adolf
videos.overview: The British plan to bomb a strategic German beach on Hitler's birthday, unaware that a major gun placement is at the site and the Allied planes will be sitting ducks. Hogan and his crew must figure out how to silence the guns in order for the air raid to be a success.

videos.title: The Gold Rush
videos.overview: A new prisoner reveals that a local bank nearby houses a shipment of gold stolen from the Bank of France by the Germans.

videos.title: Hello, Zolle
videos.overview: When Hogan informs London of an important German general’s imminent arrival at Stalag 13, he is told that he must detain the general at the camp for 24 hours—by whatever means necessary—so that Allied forces can stage a raid on the visiting general's forces.

videos.title: It Takes a Thief... Sometimes
videos.overview: Hogan is enthusiastic about joining forces with an underground unit that is targeting a local railway tunnel—unaware that the "saboteurs" are actually Gestapo agents masquerading as allies!

videos.title: The Great Impersonation
videos.overview: When LeBeau, Newkirk and Carter are captured by the Gestapo during a sabotage mission, Hogan must convince the affable Sergeant Schultz to impersonate the stern Colonel Klink and demand their release.

videos.title: The Pizza Parlor
videos.overview: When an Italian POW camp commander arrives at Stalag 13 to train under Colonel Klink, Hogan and his gang try to convince the new arrival to go to work for the Allies.

videos.title: The 43rd, a Moving Story
videos.overview: Hogan's plan to destroy a mobile Nazi anti-aircraft battery is hampered by Colonel Klink's power-hungry peer, Major Kuehn.

videos.title: How to Cook a German Goose by Radar
videos.overview: The men of Stalag 13 are turned off by an American corporal's aloof attitude and boorish behavior, until they discover he has come to the camp to ask for help in carrying out a sabotage mission.

videos.title: Psychic Kommandant
videos.overview: After a startling, deadly new German weapon (a secret, noiseless aircraft) has been brought to Stalag 13 for testing, Hogan's gang must do their best to tarnish its image.

videos.title: The Prince from the Phone Company
videos.overview: Kinchloe dresses up as an African prince, whom Hogan has kidnapped, in order to ask the Germans for money to open a submarine base. Complications arise when the prince's wife arrives.

videos.title: The Safecracker Suite
videos.overview: Colonel Klink's happy reunion with an old military buddy ends abruptly when the man is arrested by the Gestapo. Will Klink end up in the clink as well?

videos.title: I Look Better in Basic Black
videos.overview: The men of Stalag 13 have no interest in tunneling into a neighboring barracks that houses new prisoners—until they discover that the new detainees are women!

videos.title: The Assassin
videos.overview: An important German nuclear scientist must be eliminated and Hogan's crew is asked to perform the task—a plan that takes an unexpected twist when the scientist comes to Hogan and asks for help fleeing the Nazi regime.

videos.title: Cupid Comes to Stalag 13
videos.overview: Colonel Klink is desperate after General Burkhalter plays matchmaker and pairs Klink with the general's sister, Gertude. Can Hogan deflect some of the Cupid's flying arrows away for the hapless, helpless Klink?

videos.title: The Flame Grows Higher
videos.overview: Somewhere along the elaborate, intricate underground escape route there is a disastrous weak link. Determined to find it, Hogan, Newkirk and Lebeau decide to break out of Stalag 13 by following the escape route themselves.

videos.title: Request Permission to Escape
videos.overview: Jilted by his girlfriend back home, Carter requests permission to escape so that he can somehow woo her back. Hogan agrees, but only if Carter can accomplish one last task of passing bogus battle plans on to the Germans.

videos.title: Hogan Gives a Birthday Party
videos.overview: A German oil refinery is so heavily protected that allied bombers have been unable to destroy it. So, Colonel Hogan decides that the only way to fool the gunners is to use a German plane.

videos.title: The Schultz Brigade
videos.overview: When the hapless Colonel Klink reluctantly joins two other German prison camp Kommandants in a plot to discredit General Burkhalter, all three men are subsequently arrested. Hogan  and the gang must act quickly to keep their clueless Kommandant in charge of Stalag 13.

videos.title: Diamonds in the Rough
videos.overview: After being double-crossed by a female lure, Hogan and his men are confronted by a Gestapo agent who knows all about their secret operation and demands "hush" money—in the form of a million dollars in diamonds!

videos.title: Operation Briefcase
videos.overview: Hogan is unexpectedly drawn into an assassination plot against Adolf Hitler when he is ordered to deliver a briefcase rigged with explosives to a German general involved in the plot.

videos.title: The Battle of Stalag 13
videos.overview: Two German officers have new and differing plans for Stalag 13, both of which threaten Hogan's operations.

videos.title: The Rise and Fall of Sergeant Schultz
videos.overview: Hogan is stymied over how to rescue a captured member of the underground until a potential diversion,  in the form of an old World War I buddy of Sergeant Schultz, arrives at Stalag 13.

videos.title: Hogan Springs
videos.overview: Hogan manages to free four underground leaders from the Germans and smuggles the quartet into Stalag 13. But a plan to spirit the men off to freedom in England suddenly looks hopeless when a leaky pipe fills the gang's emergency tunnel with water!

videos.title: A Klink, a Bomb and a Short Fuse
videos.overview: All goes well when Hogan's gang steals Klink's code book from his safe, photographs the contents, and returns it to its proper place. But there's a small hitch: Carter forgot to load the camera with film!

videos.title: Tanks for the Memory
videos.overview: When Newkirk discovers a new radio controlled tank that could win the war for Germany, the allies want Hogan and the men to photograph the tank and then destroy it, but complication ensue during their mission.

videos.title: A Tiger Hunt In Paris (1)
videos.overview: In the first of a two-part story, "Tiger," a female underground agent, is arrested while trying to document some secret German bases and is held in Paris for questioning. So, Hogan and LeBeau become stowaways aboard Klink's staff car and head for Paris to free her.

videos.title: A Tiger Hunt In Paris (2)
videos.overview: While trying to free the underground agent "Tiger" in Paris, Hogan must seek help from a Parisian fortune teller, and also enlist the aid of a man who is a look-alike for Nazi Police Chief Heinrich Himmler.

videos.title: Will the Real Adolf Please Stand Up?
videos.overview: With camp security raised, Hogan and his men are desperate to smuggle some top-secret photos of German fortifications to the allies. The solution? Make liberal use of Carter's remarkable impersonation of Adolf Hitler.

videos.title: Don't Forget to Write
videos.overview: The aristocratic Colonel Klink fails a routine physical exam and lands a combat assignment at the Russian front! Fearing a hard-line replacement at Stalag 13, the  men must do all they can to rescind Klink's marching orders.

videos.title: Klink's Rocket
videos.overview: Hogan and his men make plans to lure Luftwaffe bombers within range of an allied anti-aircraft installation hidden in an abandoned warehouse, but Carter makes a shamble of the plan when, while "leaking" the info to Klink, he forgets the name of the town where the strategic warehouse is located.

videos.title: Information Please
videos.overview: Suspecting a security leak at Stalag 13, General Burkhalter goes fishing with some false information and Colonel Hogan falls for the bait. As a result, Burkhalter plants a spy among the prisoners to expose the guilty parties.

videos.title: Art for Hogan's Sake
videos.overview: An assertive General Burkhalter "requisitions" the famous Édouard Manet painting, "The Fife Player," from the Louvre museum in Paris to give to Hermann Goering as a birthday present. Undaunted by the seeming impossible logistics, Hogan and LeBeau decide to steal it back!

videos.title: The General Swap
videos.overview: Colonel Hogan is less than thrilled when he is assigned to help an obnoxious American general flee Stalag 13, and the secret escape plan, involving a prisoner swap, winds up as trying and difficult as the arrogant escapee himself.

videos.title: The Great Brinksmeyer Robbery
videos.overview: When the gang's hidden cache of money (needed to purchase a secret map) goes up in smoke, the men of Stalag 13 must come up with a way to replace the cash, and decide to pull off a bank heist in the nearby town.

videos.title: Praise the Führer and Pass the Ammunition
videos.overview: Hogan and his men are determined to create chaos during staged war games a ruthless Nazi colonel has scheduled near Stalag 13.

videos.title: Hogan and the Lady Doctor
videos.overview: Hogan nixes a mission to destroy a synthetic fuel plant because the caper is too risky, but he is overruled, and forced to participate in the scheme by the ploy's mastermind, a strong-willed, determined female scientist.

videos.title: The Swing Shift
videos.overview: Masquerading as German workers, Hogan and the crew have made elaborate and foolproof plans to blow a German cannon factory sky-high, but their plan backfires when Newkirk winds up being drafted into the German army!

videos.title: Heil Klink
videos.overview: When an important Gestapo official wants to defect, Hogan brings him to Stalag 13, and convinces Colonel Klink that the fugitive is Adolf Hitler in disguise.

videos.title: Everyone Has a Brother-in-Law
videos.overview: Captain Kurtz, General Burkhalter's annoying, ambitious brother-in-law, becomes the camp's tough new adjutant. What's worse he's keeping a watchful eye on every corner of Stalag 13, and ends up getting in the way of Hogan's plans to blow up an enemy munitions train.

videos.title: Killer Klink
videos.overview: The bumbling Sergent Schultz has unwittingly been conned into making a trip to Heidelberg as courier for the underground, but after upsetting Colonel Klink, the sergeant is ordered to remain grounded at the camp. How will Hogan and the gang win him a new weekend pass?

videos.title: Reverend Kommandant Klink
videos.overview: When a French flier is captured, the Nazis verbally malign the man's fiancée in an attempt to get him to reveal important information. Hogan must find a way to keep him from cracking under the manipulative interrogation.

videos.title: The Most Escape-Proof Camp I've Ever Escaped From
videos.overview: Colonel Klink's "no escape" record is jeopardized when Malcolm Flood, a British escape artist, lands in Stalag 13 and intends to continue his impressive escape record.

videos.title: The Tower
videos.overview: When the Nazis construct a new communication tower near Stalag 13, Hogan enlists the help of a beautiful underground agent to destroy the tower, with Kinchloe assigned to snap some incriminating photos of General Burkhalter.

videos.title: Colonel Klink's Secret Weapon
videos.overview: After receiving a "poor' rating from the Inspector General of prison camps, Colonel Klink brings in a stern new sergeant to discipline the prisoners. How can Hogan and his men make sure the camp's ruthless "discipline machine" has the shortest reign possible?

videos.title: The Top Secret Top Coat
videos.overview: A secret military document is mistakenly hidden in Colonel Klink's topcoat at a party, and a desperate Hogan must nab the document because of both its value to the allies, and because Klink will be charged with treason and replaced at Stalag 13 if it is discovered in his possession.

videos.title: The Reluctant Target
videos.overview: Klink becomes convinced that he is marked for assassination by a mysterious "Mr. X" after a series of close calls at the stalag.

videos.title: The Crittendon Plan
videos.overview: Colonel Hogan is called on to destroy a German convoy inside a tunnel, but he balks when he discovers that his accomplice will be his old adversary, Colonel Crittendon.

videos.title: Some of Their Planes Are Missing
videos.overview: The Germans' plan to shoot down British bombers by using captured RAF airplanes is uncovered, and Hogan and his men must attempt to destroy the aircraft before they can be flown on their deadly, deceptive mission.

videos.title: D-Day at Stalag 13
videos.overview: Hogan and his men play a part in the D-Day invasion of France when they are asked to create a diversion that will delay Colonel Klink and other German officials at Stalag 13 from retaliating once the invasion is underway.

videos.title: Sergeant Schultz Meets Mata Hari
videos.overview: Sergent Schultz falls head over heels for an attractive woman, but Hogan suspects that she is a Gestapo agent and has Carter shadow the two loverbirds on one of their dates.

videos.title: Funny Thing Happened on the Way to London
videos.overview: Newkirk, Kinchloe and LeBeau must help Hogan thwart the Nazis' planned assassination plot against British Prime Minister Winston Churchill.

videos.title: Casanova Klink
videos.overview: Klink's new secretary Gertude Linkmeyer decides to throw herself into the task of completely organizing the commandant's workplace—an all-night project that throws a monkey wrench into Hogan's mission of raiding the safe in Klink's office.

videos.title: How to Win Friends and Influence  Nazis
videos.overview: A famed scientist is recruited by the Germans to develop a revolutionary new metal alloy for the Nazi war machine. Hogan and the gang must keep him from accomplishing his task.

videos.title: Nights in Shining Armor
videos.overview: Hogan must somehow deliver a shipment of bulletproof vests to the French underground.

videos.title: Hot Money
videos.overview: Stalag 13 becomes the site for a German counterfeiting factory that will produce both American and British currencies. But Sergeant Schultz's sticky fingers inadvertently tip Hogan off to the scheme when Schultzy spends some of the "funny money" gambling with the prisoners.

videos.title: One in Every Crowd
videos.overview: When Hogan and his men set out to destroy the Germans' new S-5 gun that's being guarded at Stalag 13, they uncover more then they bargained for—a traitor amongst their ranks who has gone to Colonel Klink to report on Hogan's planned sabotage.

videos.title: Is General Hammerschlag Burning?
videos.overview: Paris is targeted for destruction should the Allied armies invade, so Hogan and Kinchloe secretly travel to the French capital to learn more about the plot.

videos.title: A Russian is Coming
videos.overview: Hogan and his men face the difficult task of returning a Soviet pilot to his homeland. The task is made more difficult by the fanatical, demanding Russian refusing to follow the usual escape route to England.

videos.title: An Evening of Generals
videos.overview: Hogan and his men have cleverly rigged the tabletop centerpieces to explode during a banquet for Germany's top generals, unaware the one of the guests at the banquets is an invaluable spy working undercover for the Allies.

videos.title: Everybody Loves a Snowman
videos.overview: An American military captain and his crew hiding out at Stalag 13 face capture when Major Hochstetter and his search party zero in on the POW camp, and its elaborate tunnel system to freedom is threatened with exposure.

videos.title: The Hostage
videos.overview: A rocket fuel depot that the Germans build near Stalag 13 is a tempting target for Hogan and his men. But is the new facility just part of a plan to lure Hogan into a trap?

videos.title: Carter Turns Traitor
videos.overview: To get the inside secrets of a Nazi chemical warfare facility, Hogan and his cohorts must convince the Germans that Carter has turned traitor and wishes to defect to the Third Reich.

videos.title: Two Nazis for the Price of One
videos.overview: Hogan's surreptitious operation, as well as secret information on America's atom bomb project, is threatened when it's discovered that a top Gestapo official knows all about Hogan's espionage activities and plans to offer him a deal.

videos.title: Is There a Doctor in the House?
videos.overview: Colonel Klink's sudden bout with the flu jeopardizes Hogan's plan to smuggle an underground agent out of the camp in the trunk of the ailing Kommandant's automobile.

videos.title: Hogan, Go Home
videos.overview: Colonel Hogan receives a stunning message: he's to return home to the U.S.A. for a hero's welcome. The men of Stalag 13, convinced the Hogan will remain at the camp to continue his operation, are further stunned when he is overjoyed at the news—and plans to bid Stalag 13 a fond farewell!

videos.title: Sticky Wicket Newkirk
videos.overview: Corporal Newkirk sneaks into town for a romantic rendezvous with a German girl, one who professes that she is on the side of the Allies. But when Newkirk sneaks her into the camp and shows her the gang's secret setup, she promptly reports her findings to Major Hochstetter!

videos.title: War Takes a Holiday
videos.overview: After a first attempt to sneak four underground leaders out of the German camp fails, Hogan and his men come up with a new plan: Convince the camp commanders that the war is over!

videos.title: Duel of Honor
videos.overview: Hogan and the gang decide that the hapless Colonel Klink would be the ideal patsy to use to get an important list of agents safely to England, with a little boost from Carter's masquerade as a ferocious German general with a fondness for duels.

videos.title: Axis Annie
videos.overview: Hogan must deliver important information to a contact in the nearby town, but the Gestapo has cracked down tight on the camp.

videos.title: What Time Does the Balloon Go Up?
videos.overview: Has Colonel Hogan finally snapped under the pressure of confinement? The men think so when Hogan suggests that, to rescue a captured British agent, the men of Stalag 13 take up basket weaving, tent making and kite flying!

videos.title: LeBeau and the Little Old Lady
videos.overview: LeBeau's weekly visits to an underground contact, one he describes as a "mean little old lady,”  are revealed as something more after Hogan and the men discover that the "old lady" is actually a beautiful, young Dutch woman with whom LeBeau has fallen in love.

videos.title: How to Escape From Prison Camp Without Really Trying
videos.overview: Hogan is asked to immobilize the entire German 6th SS division—10,000 men—for two days, while the Allies organize a surprise attack. The task seems impossible, especially in the presence of the two stern Gestapo colonels who are filling in for a vacationing Colonel Klink.

videos.title: The Collector General
videos.overview: An arrogant German general arrives at Stalag 13 and orders Colonel Klink to guard a truckload of ammunition. But when Hogan discovers that the "ammo" is actually a collection of valuable pieces of art stolen from France, he masterminds a little theft of his own.

videos.title: The Ultimate Weapon
videos.overview: The Germans' new top-secret weapon becomes—Sergeant Schultz? General Burkhalter and the other camp officials believe he is, after Schutzy starts to predict Allied attacks with uncanny accuracy!

videos.title: Monkey Business
videos.overview: Carter returns from an unsuccessful mission with a new pal in tow—a runaway chimpanzee from the local bombed-out zoo.

videos.title: Drums Along the Dusseldorf
videos.overview: A German truck carrying an experimental jet fuel is the latest target for Hogan and the gang. But when all efforts to sabotage the shipment fail, Carter decides to get down to business with the remaining weaponry at hand—a bow and arrow!

videos.title: Clearance Sale at the Black Market
videos.overview: It appears Sergeant Schultz will be shipped off to the Russian front after he accidentally interrupts a black market meeting. If he goes, Colonel Hogan will lose his courier of secret messages between Stalag 13 and a female spy.

videos.title: Klink vs. the Gonculator
videos.overview: When Sergeant Carter constructs an amazingly complicated rabbit trap, a suspicious Colonel Klink comes to believe that the contraption is a secret electronic spying device.

videos.title: How to Catch a Papa Bear
videos.overview: Colonel Hogan innocently sends Corporal Newkirk off on a mission to rendezvous with an ally—unaware that the meeting is a trap set up by the Gestapo.

videos.title: Hogan's Trucking Service ... We Deliver the Factory to You
videos.overview: The clumsy and annoying Colonel Crittendon inadvertently messes up Hogan's plans to destroy a German ball-bearing plant.

videos.title: To the Gestapo with Love
videos.overview: Is love blind? Three beautiful German girls arrive at Stalag 13 and set the men's hearts beating faster, but their mission is to pry secrets out of the love-struck POWs.

videos.title: Man's Best Friend is Not His Dog
videos.overview: A canine caper is off and running when a dog buries a bone containing photographic images of a new German tank that Carter had taken with his camera.

videos.title: Never Play Cards with Strangers
videos.overview: Hogan dispatches Sergeant Kinchloe on a mission to warn Newkirk and Carter that the duo's mission to dynamite a newly-established Nazi rocket fuel installation could blow up in their faces.

videos.title: Color the Luftwaffe Red
videos.overview: How will Hogan steal an important, strategic map from the Germans? By underbidding all competitors for the contract to paint the offices of Luftwaffe headquarters.

videos.title: Guess Who Came to Dinner?
videos.overview: After making arrangements to send her to England, Hogan begins to worry that his beautiful underground contact, Heidi, might actually be a double agent.

videos.title: No Names Please
videos.overview: Shortly after Hogan helps a journalist escape to freedom, the Germans are amazed to read an American newspaper story about a sabotage-and-subterfuge unit hard at work right under their noses at one of their POW camps.

videos.title: Bad Day in Berlin
videos.overview: Hogan and his men join forces with an undercover agent and steal away to Berlin to nab a German defector who can compromise their entire operation at Stalag 13.

videos.title: Will the Blue Baron Strike Again?
videos.overview: Can Hogan locate the secret German air base commanded by a World War I flying ace known as the Blue Baron? Yes --- by convincing Colonel Klink to throw a party for the famed aviator.

videos.title: Will the Real Colonel Klink Please Stand Up Against the Wall?
videos.overview: The hapless Colonel Klink lands a date with a German firing squad after Sergeant Carter, disguised as Klink, is spotted at a sabotage site.

videos.title: Man in a Box
videos.overview: Hogan is ordered to capture an "escaped" Corporal Louis LeBeau --- but in a manner that will ensure LeBeau's completion of an espionage caper.

videos.title: The Missing Klink
videos.overview: Hogan's scheme to kidnap General Burkhalter and trade him for an underground agent goes awry when Colonel Klink --- not the general --- is the one who gets kidnapped.

videos.title: Who Stole My Copy of Mein Kampf?
videos.overview: Hogan and his men plan to eliminate an allied defector, but complications ensue when their target turns out to be a beautiful woman.

videos.title: Operation Hannibal
videos.overview: A German general is the mastermind behind a plan designed to prolong the war, so Hogan winds up working with the general's daughter in an effort to photograph the strategic documents.

videos.title: My Favorite Prisoner
videos.overview: When Colonel Klink uses a beautiful baroness to try to wheedle secrets out of Colonel Hogan, he apparently falls under the femme fatale's charms. Or does he?

videos.title: Watch the Trains Go By
videos.overview: Hogan's plan to sneak out of Stalag 13 and blow up a German train hinges on getting General Burkhalter's lovelorn sister --- the marriage-minded Gertrude --- to distract Colonel Klink.

videos.title: Klink's Old Flame
videos.overview: The French underground is in desperate need of valuable radios, so Hogan decides to utilize Colonel Klink's former girlfriend to ensure the delivery of the equipment.

videos.title: Up in Klink's Room
videos.overview: Hogan must somehow get himself hospitalized so that he can get top-secret information from a wounded British agent who has been posing as a Nazi officer.

videos.title: The Purchasing Plan
videos.overview: The race is on when Hogan and his men are ordered to collect air-dropped ammunition and distribute it to underground units widely scattered around the region.

videos.title: The Witness
videos.overview: Hogan is stunned to learn that the Germans are planning to send him to England, with a startling message for the Allied forces: surrender, or face the Nazis' "ultimate weapon."

videos.title: The Big Dish
videos.overview: Hogan's latest mission: destroy an elaborate anti-aircraft defense system designed by a beautiful English woman who has defected to Germany.

videos.title: The Return of Major Bonacelli
videos.overview: An Italian officer, who once studied under Colonel Klink, is the ideal candidate to assist Hogan and his men in a daring plan to photograph a new Nazi gun installation.

videos.title: Happy Birthday, Dear Hogan
videos.overview: To celebrate Colonel Hogan's birthday with a bang, his men plan to surprise him by blowing up a Nazi ammunition dump. But will the merry celebrants fall into an elaborate trap set by the Germans?

videos.title: Hogan Goes Hollywood
videos.overview: To transmit information home, Colonel Hogan plans to cast an American actor to star in a German propaganda film.

videos.title: The Well
videos.overview: Hogan steals the Luftwaffe codebook, but can't use it after Newkirk accidentally drops it down a well.

videos.title: The Klink Commandos
videos.overview: In order to steal key documents, Hogan and his men volunteer for a German suicide-squad train bound for the Russian front.

videos.title: The Gasoline War
videos.overview: Hogan and his men plan to demolish a gasoline station that's just been built in camp.

videos.title: Unfair Exchange
videos.overview: Hogan kidnaps General Burkhalter's sister, with the intention of exchanging her for a captured Allied agent.

videos.title: The Kommandant Dies at Dawn
videos.overview: Colonel Klink is set up for execution after the gestapo finds him with underground information --- planted on him by Hogan.

videos.title: Bombsight
videos.overview: A new weapon is about to be tested and Hogan schemes to get the blueprints to foil its detonation.

videos.title: The Big Picture
videos.overview: When the Gestapo blackmails Klink, Hogan plans to steal the incriminating photo.

videos.title: The Big Gamble
videos.overview: Hogan plots to keep a secret device, hidden on board a downed plane, from the Germans.

videos.title: The Defector
videos.overview: A defecting Field Marshal tailed by Major Hochstetter to Stalag 13 needs Hogan's help to get to England.

videos.title: The Empty Parachute
videos.overview: By planting an opened parachute in camp, Hogan tricks the Germans into looking for an Allied agent --- so he can find the missing briefcase that was handcuffed to a courier.

videos.title: The Antique
videos.overview: Hogan convinces Klink to open a business selling "rare" cuckoo clocks, which Hogan plans to use for smuggling information.

videos.title: Is There a Traitor in the House?
videos.overview: Hogan plans to filter information into London through the wires of a German propaganda radio broadcast.

videos.title: At Last - Schultz Knows Something
videos.overview: Hogan prods Sergeant Schultz to reveal the site of a secret atomic installation that Schultz has been assigned to guard.

videos.title: How's the Weather?
videos.overview: Hogan throws an anniversary party for Klink, planning to use party balloons to forecast the weather.

videos.title: Get Fit or Go Fight
videos.overview: Hogan convinces Klink to get back in shape so he won't be shipped to the Russian front.

videos.title: Fat Hermann, Go Home
videos.overview: Things heat up as Hogan schemes to return a load of stolen paintings to London, just as Marya convinces Schultz to impersonate Reich Marshal Goering.

videos.title: The Softer They Fall
videos.overview: "Kinch" agrees to fight a German boxing champ to divert attention from a heist that Hogan is planning.

videos.title: Gowns by Yvette
videos.overview: By having LeBeau design her gown, Hogan plans to use the wedding of Burkhalter's niece as a smokescreen to smuggle a defector out of Germany.

videos.title: One Army at a Time
videos.overview: When he's captured in German uniform, Carter convinces the Germans that he is one of them.

videos.title: Standing Room Only
videos.overview: Hogan tries to save Klink from the officer who wants to turn him in for his lousy bookkeeping skills.

videos.title: Six Lessons From Madame LaGrange
videos.overview: With the help of a singer, Hogan schemes to prevent the Gestapo from arresting all the local Allied agents.

videos.title: The Sergeant's Analyst
videos.overview: Schultz is headed for the Russian front because Burkhalter caught him goofing off.

videos.title: The Merry Widow
videos.overview: To transport secret documents, Hogan sets up Klink with a female agent --- but when the wrong documents fall into Klink's hands, Schultz becomes the delivery boy.

videos.title: Crittendon's Commandos
videos.overview: On a mission to capture Rommel, Colonel Crittendon and his commandos parachute into camp, but the Colonel is the only one to avoid capture.

videos.title: Klink's Escape
videos.overview: Hogan gets Klink to believe he is about to bust a POW escape ring.

videos.title: Cuisine à la Stalag 13
videos.overview: Colonel Hogan needs LeBeau to whip up something special for a German general, but the chef has made plans to escape to France.

videos.title: The Experts
videos.overview: When the Gestapo targets Colonel Klink's radio expert, Hogan helps save him before he's silenced for good.

videos.title: Klink's Masterpiece
videos.overview: Hogan convinces Klink that he is a great artist so he can smuggle out some maps in the Kommandant's canvases.

videos.title: Lady Chitterly's Lover (1)
videos.overview: Part 1 of 2. When Sir Charles Chitterly parachutes into Stalag 13, Hogan asks Colonel Crittendon to pretend he's Sir Charles --- but Lady Chitterly isn't fooled.

videos.title: Lady Chitterly's Lover (2)
videos.overview: Part 2 of 2. Hogan fears the phony Sir Charles can't trick Hitler. Things get even more complicated when Chitterly escapes from the prisoner's tunnel.

videos.title: The Gestapo Takeover
videos.overview: The heroes try to prevent the Gestapo from sending Klink and Schultz to the Russian front.

videos.title: Kommandant Schultz
videos.overview: When Schultz is put in command, his mania for power jeopardizes Hogan's plan to smuggle uranium to London.

videos.title: Eight O'Clock and All is Well
videos.overview: Right after he tells a new prisoner about their secret operations, Hogan discovers he's a German spy.

videos.title: The Big Record
videos.overview: When Klink gives the heroes a tape recorder so they can send messages back home, Hogan has bigger plans for the device.

videos.title: It's Dynamite
videos.overview: Hogan's plot to hijack a dynamite truck takes a different tack when the truck makes an unscheduled stop.

videos.title: Operation Tiger
videos.overview: Hogan and his men mastermind the ambush of a Gestapo train that's transporting an underground agent to Berlin.

videos.title: The Big Broadcast
videos.overview: The heroes use Klink's car radio to pass information to an underground agent about a German rocket factory.

videos.title: The Gypsy
videos.overview: To smuggle out an anti-radar device, Hogan passes LeBeau off as a fortune-teller after convincing Klink he's been struck by lightning.

videos.title: The Dropouts
videos.overview: When three Gestapo officers detain Hogan and Carter, the two frantically plan their escape --- until they learn the officers want to defect.

videos.title: Easy Come, Easy Go
videos.overview: Klink takes Hogan to England to steal an Allied plane, but Hogan has other plans --- to expose some Nazi spies.

videos.title: The Meister Spy
videos.overview: The heroes pose a Nazi officers to root out a German spy posing as an American pilot.

videos.title: That's No Lady, That's My Spy
videos.overview: Dressed as a general's wife, Newkirk attends a tea party to deliver penicillin to an underground leader.

videos.title: To Russia Without Love
videos.overview: To get ahold of secret papers, Hogan enlists a beautiful Russian spy to convince Klink he's needed at the Russian front.

videos.title: Klink for the Defense
videos.overview: When Klink gets assigned to defend a German officer accused of treason, Hogan helps to prove his innocence.

videos.title: The Kamikazes Are Coming
videos.overview: When a rocket lands near camp, the heroes don't know how they'll smuggle it out --- until Russian spy Marya comes on the scene.

videos.title: Kommandant Gertrude
videos.overview: General Burkhalter's sister Gertrude thinks her dim-witted fiance should be made Klink's assistant, which interferes with Hogan's plan to aid an American general.

videos.title: Hogan's Double Life
videos.overview: When Gestapo agents accuse Hogan of sabotage, he explains that his exact double, a German traitor, is the real culprit.

videos.title: Look at the Pretty Snowflakes
videos.overview: Hogan and his men start an avalanche to prevent Panzer tanks from reaching their destination.

videos.title: Rockets or Romance
videos.overview: Hogan and a beautiful underground agent team up to immobilize three mobile rocket launchers.

awards: Won 2 Primetime Emmys. 3 wins & 11 nominations total
